idea: Little science wonder – FLOAT or SINK? (PLAYROOM, at the small round wooden table with a big clear glass bowl of water): a yellow rubber duck drops into the bowl with a SPLASH right in front of Baby Jimmy and floats ('Splash! Wow! My duck can float!'); he drops a gray rock – PLOP – and it sinks down, down, down to the bottom ('Sink, sink, sink!'); copy-me 'Float – arms up high! Sink – bend down low!'; he holds up a red apple and asks the viewer 'Float or sink? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – the apple FLOATS ('It floats! It floats! Yay!'); lesson 'Duck and apple float! The rock sinks!'. Loop: the hook framing again with the duck and the apple floating and the rock on the bottom, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Some things float on top of the water (rubber duck, apple) and some things sink to the bottom (rock) – look and find out!
calendar: Saturday slot 2 – Little science wonder (earlier: seeds grow 31 Oct). Float/sink is new.
characters: BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue short-sleeve onesie with a small yellow star, barefoot.
supporting: THE WATER BOWL: a big round clear glass bowl of clean clear water on the small round wooden table. YELLOW RUBBER DUCK with an orange beak (floats). ONE smooth round GRAY ROCK, fist-size (sinks). ONE shiny RED APPLE with a brown stem and a green leaf (floats).
setting: PLAYROOM (magic crayon room): a cozy playroom with a colorful puzzle foam floor mat, light blue walls with rainbow pictures, wooden shelves with colorful toy bins, books and toy blocks, a blue bean bag with a yellow star cushion, and a small round wooden table with four little chairs (blue, pink, yellow and green), a big white paper and a box of rainbow crayons on it. Bright, warm, magical lighting with tiny floating sparkles.

learning.goal: Find out what floats and what sinks: the rubber duck and the apple float on top of the water, the rock sinks to the bottom.
learning.shown_how: A big CLEAR glass bowl so the child sees both the top of the water (duck, apple floating) and the bottom (rock lying there) through the glass; one item at a time in order duck -> rock -> apple.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:13 'My red apple… float or sink? Hmm?' + 0:16-0:18 humming-only pause (question boing) -> 0:18 'It floats! It floats! Yay!' + cheer
learning.copy_me: 0:10 'Float – arms up high! Sink – bend down low!'
learning.fact_check: Rubber duck floats (true), rock sinks (true), apple floats (true – apples are about 25% air). Frames: one duck, one rock, one apple; rock absent in shots 1-2, in hand in shot 3 start, on the bottom in shots 4-5; apple absent in shots 1-3, held above water in shot 4 start, floating in shot 5. No letters/numbers anywhere.
learning.modeling: Jimmy experiments calmly at a table with a small bowl of water; tidy, no mess, no climbing.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, soft daylight, big clear bowl beside his face, nothing scary.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: SPLASH! the duck lands in the water
interactive pause: Float or sink? Hmm?
say-it-with-me: float / sink / down, down, down
copy-me: arms up high = float, bend down low = sink

story_order.rock: absent shots 1-2, held above water at the start of shot 3 then dropped and sinks, on the bottom in shots 4-5
story_order.apple: absent shots 1-3, held above the water at the start of shot 4 then floats, floating in shot 5
